stem: Canopy work stopped in one zone after suspicious pest signs. What should the record preserve?
choices: Mark the whole room complete because most canopy work was finished before the stop.
Record which plants or zone were completed, which area was held, the observed pest evidence, sanitation response, escalation, and unresolved status.
Record a confirmed pest diagnosis so the next shift knows why the work stopped.
Omit the hold and let the next shift decide whether the area should remain isolated.
rationale: When work stops because of a plant-health concern, the record should separate completed from held scope and preserve the actual evidence and response. A confirmed diagnosis should not be invented, and the hold status should not be left ambiguous. The next shift needs a clear continuation point.
